heard.say:
Narrator: press 1 to play as Mike
Press 2 to play as Carter

Carter: Hell yeah, brother! How utterly correct of you to recognize my big protagonist energy!
Mike: Press 1 to open the door and enter the dungeon!
Carter: Thanks Mike.

Tony Hawk: Cameo clip
Narrator: Tony Hawk has bestowed upon you a skateboard of courage.
Carter: Holy Shit! I can't believe the actual real Tony Hawk was in the room with me just now!
Mike: Yeah and nobody paid him at all.
Narrator: Press 1 to continue.

Narrator: As Tony (we're on a first name basis) erm, as Tony skates away, you notice something on the ground.
Carter: Hey Mr. Hawk, you forgot your helmet!
Mike: perhaps this is yet another boon he hath bestowed upon us.
Carter: why are you talking like that?
Mike: <coughs> sorry. Press 1 to put on the helmet. Press 2 to give the helmet to mike(Thats me!).  Press 3 to leave it behind.

Carter: safety first!
Mike: we can't let Tony down!
Carter: ...Are you on a first name basis with Tony hawk?

Narrator: As you continue down the dank dungeon corridor, the moss covered cobblestone of the walls and ceiling give way to equally moss covered natural rock. You have clearly passed into a cave, though the path you walk remains evidently paved. It's as if was constructed specifically to facilitate your journey. The cave briefly opens into swampy lagoon, giving you an opportunity to split from the path.
Carter: oh boy, a decision! Do NOT fuck this up i swear to god.
Mike: what is this, minecraft? <slap>
Narrator: Press 1 to turn left and wade through the lily pads. Press 2 to continue to the right into a vine covered cave.

Mike: Lily pads? Hip hip!
Both: Hooray!
Mike: Hip hip!
Both: Hooray!
Narrator: "The cave opens up into a wide open pool, in the center of which is some sort of frog wizard, perched on a giant lily pad."
Mike: Dude is that who I think it is.
Carter: If that's froggum duder I'm going to freak out.
Froggum: Oh fuck these guys again.
Mike: Press 1 to ask him if he'll teach us some spells! Press 2 to pass by so as not to bother him. Press 3 to cast a spell of your own to scare him away.
